description: Payments portal service template (illustrative). Node templates carry the architecture-plane workload URN / edge id each maps to, in metadata.governs; the policies below join to the architecture plane through the templates they target.

web-to-api-availability.description: The web->api path must meet the portal's availability SLA.

properties.justification: Card authorization requests fail if the web->api hop is unavailable during business hours.

db-data-residency.description: Cardholder data may not leave the regulated region.

properties.justification: PCI-DSS and local data-residency law require cardholder data to remain in-region.
